# TUNR

> TUNR is a free app for Georgia's car scene: find car meets, car shows and cruise-ins near you, RSVP, get directions and see who's going. Hosts post meets for free. Works in any phone browser and installs to the home screen.

TUNR is made by Boosted Studios LLC (boostedstudiosllc@gmail.com), based in Georgia, USA. It covers the whole state, mostly metro Atlanta (Atlanta, Alpharetta, Marietta, Buford, Kennesaw, Lawrenceville and more).

## Find meets

- [Car meets in Georgia](https://tunr-gules.vercel.app/meets): every upcoming public meet, soonest first, with date, time, place and host. Updated live.
- City pages: https://tunr-gules.vercel.app/meets/<city>, for example [Atlanta](https://tunr-gules.vercel.app/meets/atlanta).
- Each meet has its own page at https://tunr-gules.vercel.app/m/<slug> with schema.org Event data (date, place, cancelled or on).
- [Sitemap](https://tunr-gules.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)

## For hosts

- [Post your meet free](https://tunr-gules.vercel.app/hosts): add a flyer and TUNR reads the date, time and place. Meets get a map pin, RSVPs, a guest list, reminders, and alerts if they're moved or cancelled.

## What else is in the app

- Linkups and "Who's down?": quick cruises, photo shoots and hangouts today or tomorrow.
- Parts marketplace that checks whether a part fits the buyer's car (make, model, year, trim and features like adaptive headlights).
- Car clubs, forums, photo spots, a 3D garage, Boost Day bonus points, and car games.
- TUNR+ is an optional paid membership; everything above is free.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Private meets are not public: their location is only shared with people the host lets in.
- Meet times are local Georgia time (America/New_York).
